outcome: Linear growth in mice after fecal transplantation
cohort: 30 pairs of healthy pre-pubertal siblings aged 3-10 years, each comprising one sibling with idiopathic short stature (ISS) and one with normal height
finding: Children with ISS had different gut microbiota composition and fecal metabolomics compared to their normal-height siblings, particularly a higher prevalence of the phylum Euryarchaeota and the species Methanobrevibacter.
